none: PAS NLM-97CBD2: Roman Coin: Nummus of Crispus
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Crispus (317-326), Beata Tranquillitas issue of 321-323, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped right. Obverse inscription: [-]RISP[--]NOB CAES. Reverse description: Globe on altar inscribed V[--], three stars above. Reverse inscription: [BEATA TRANQV]ILLITAS. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 17.8mm, Weight: 2.04gms, die axis: 12
